name: cn-memes-abroad
description: A local-first desktop app for organizing Chinese stickers and sending them to WhatsApp

scripts.package:mac:official: npm run vx-plugin:stage && npm run build && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.official.yml --mac --dir
scripts.package:mac:community:arm64: node --import tsx scripts/sharp-x64-deps.ts clean && npm run build && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.community.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.package:mac:official:arm64: node --import tsx scripts/sharp-x64-deps.ts clean && npm run vx-plugin:stage && npm run build && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.official.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.package:mac:community:x64: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/sharp-x64-deps.ts build-x64 build/electron-builder.community.yml
scripts.package:mac:official:x64: npm run vx-plugin:stage && npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/sharp-x64-deps.ts build-x64 build/electron-builder.official.yml
scripts.phase7:native:build: npm run phase7:helper:build && npm run phase7:instrumentation:build
scripts.vx-plugin:stage: npm run phase7:native:build && node --import tsx scripts/stage-vx-plugin.ts
scripts.vx-plugin:package: npm run vx-plugin:stage && node --import tsx scripts/package-vx-plugin.ts
scripts.phase7:instrumentation:test: npm run phase7:helper:build && npm run phase7:instrumentation:build && node --import tsx scripts/test-wechat4-instrumentation.ts
scripts.phase7:load-gate:test: npm run phase7:instrumentation:build && node --import tsx scripts/test-wechat4-load-gate.ts
scripts.phase7:gate-g: npm run phase7:helper:build && npm run phase7:instrumentation:build && node --import tsx scripts/run-wechat4-gate-g.ts
scripts.phase7:lifecycle:test: npm run phase7:helper:build && node --import tsx scripts/test-wechat4-lifecycle.ts
scripts.phase8:store-gate-8:preflight: npm run phase7:helper:build && npm run phase8:store-instrumentation:build && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx electron scripts/run-wechat4-store-gate-8.ts --preflight
scripts.phase8:store-gate-8: npm run phase7:helper:build && npm run phase8:store-instrumentation:build && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx electron scripts/run-wechat4-store-gate-8.ts
